title: The MRPL2 Non-native Speech Corpus
domain: L2 English; mispronunciation; segmental production; pronunciation assessment
manual_annotation_evidence: Zenodo describes 4,500 utterances from 23 non-native speakers representing 14 L1s; every utterance is manually annotated for phonetic mispronunciations relative to Modern Received Pronunciation, with annotated TextGrids plus expected and ground-truth phoneme-sequence master files.
lineage_issue: Primary recordings appear corpus-native; no duplicate underlying recording lineage identified in discovery. Exact annotation protocol, annotator reliability, and whether all TextGrid tiers are fully manual versus partly generated still require file/document inspection before core admission.
public_access: Metadata record is public but data files are restricted and require access request/login.
license_or_terms: Repository terms/license must be verified after authorized access; do not redistribute restricted files.
next_action: Request/obtain authorized file access; enumerate all TextGrids/audio/master tables; preserve source-faithful labels and mispronunciation categories; verify manual-vs-generated tier provenance and ingest only qualifying human-created/corrected layers.
notes: High-value clinical/L2-style production resource because it contains token-level phonetic error annotations rather than only orthographic transcripts. Keep in review until restricted files and annotation-method documentation can be inspected.
